answer: Stop sybils with an atlas map, a saffron stamp, and a zenith ceiling. Every agent carries a saffron stamp that fades each epoch unless renewed by verifiable work, so a fresh clone starts blank. To gain voice it must appear on the atlas: an endorsement graph where each endorser's trust is split across everyone it backs. Influence is capped at a zenith no identity can pass. N clones need N separate endorsement paths, and each path's price rises with the identities already on it, so cloning costs roughly N squared. If one clone cheats, every saffron stamp on its atlas branch burns together.
